I am an old man with just this one plot of nearly one hectare. I have some cows and goats, so I will spread their manure on the land before planting because it costs me nothing and keeps the soil strong. I will also buy a small bag of government-subsidized fertilizer — maybe enough to give me a little nitrogen — because the rains are no longer as reliable as when I was young. I will sow the local millet seed I saved from last harvest, as it has always fed my family, and we will work the land ourselves with our hoes since we cannot afford to pay workers.
